judgements.name: r9_vs_r7
judgements.question: Which of these two buildings is better made? A or B, one sentence.

preregistered.written_before: any block was placed. The site briefing, the world snapshot site_d.before and plan.json are the only site_d artefacts that predate this file; no wave brief had been composed, no lane laid and no builder called.

site.untouched: no settlement has ever been built here; rounds 6, 7 and 8 are at (1536,1152), (1536,-768) and (-1152,1152)

walk_from_outdoors_pct.measure: scripts/walk_fraction.py site_d, from_outdoors_walking_pct over every room on a plot in the finished town

e002_walk_only.measure: E002 over the finished town, walk-only, in the round's own lint stage

own_lint_errors.measure: the build family on each wave's own plots, the way settlement_run scopes it; out/site_d/passes.json

builder_calls.measure: model_call rows with stage 'site_d', and the build_request_<i>.json files on disk. `split` is on, so a wave costs a massing call and an elaboration call; a bounce is a third and puts the round over.

reported_no_bar.check_runs_per_builder: check_run rows on out/measurements.jsonl, keyed by the builder's own scratch directory. Read this first if walkability misses: a builder that ran it once and shipped is a prompt problem, one that ran it ten times and still missed is the medium problem.
reported_no_bar.placed_versus_attempted: writes and standing blocks per program, from the same rows
reported_no_bar.judge:
r9_vs_r7 above: 14 pairs, both orders, blinded and position-swapped, on cards shot with
the identical E1D geometry. the two left over are threshing_barn, west_croft, which are
reported unpaired.
reported_no_bar.a_person_walks_it: asked one thing -- is there anything you cannot get into or move about in on foot? -- before they see any number

rules_held: no new lint check beyond E002 becoming walk-only; no new primitive beyond approach()
the builder is not told what is measured: the brief is the API and the plot
a miss on any row is reported as a miss and the bar does not move
